articles.title_en: India is one of Russia’s biggest energy buyers. Can it also help broker peace with Ukraine?
articles.lead_en: India is beginning to take a more active role in efforts to reach a settlement between Russia and Ukraine, Indian Foreign Minister Subrahmanyam Jaishankar said. Bloomberg reported that his explicit statement signals New Delhi’s shift toward a more active stance after years of caution over the war, driven partly by its close economic ties with Russia.
